summary: Add Claude Code /check, /test and /feature commands, read-only architect and reviewer agents, and a harness guide for long-lived repos.
description: Give Claude Code workflow commands for checking, testing and building features, plus read-only architect and reviewer agents. A docs/harness.md guide explains each guard layer the claude-harness hooks add. Leave it out with the lean preset for short, timed work.

plain.whatItIs: Adds workflow commands, review agents and a guide to the Claude Code setup of a TypeScript project that uses Bun.
goodAt: Running the project's checks and tests from one Claude Code command
Getting a read-only design or code review from a separate agent
Explaining the project's agent guards to the next maintainer
notGoodAt: Short, timed tasks where the hooks alone are enough.
Projects that do not use Claude Code.
